answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The zenith lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the umber is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work.
